known_issues: Circular import hermes.py <-> domain.py: fixed via _lazy()/_wrap_model() lazy imports
Version property recursion: fixed with _version backing field
Tools endpoint double-wrapping: fixed by extracting tools array from list_tools()
Ollama IPv6 bind failure: default changed to 127.0.0.1:11434 (not localhost)
Missing automations.create tool: implemented _t_automation_create in hermes.py:1427
Missing career.ats_analyze tool: created app/career.py + job_description column in schema.sql
_lazy() wrapper passed args wrong: fixed to unpack **args for domain functions
MCP SSRF protection: DNS pinning, IP validation, byte caps, redirect blocking implemented
Approval timeout (30s default): added expires_at column + cleanup job in prefs.py/hermes.py
Scheduler lock: threading.Lock prevents overlapping ticks in hermes.py
Streaming deduplication: real-time token yield vs final replay in orchestrator.py
Stop Generating button: composer, call overlay, voice loop in store.tsx/ui.tsx
Autoplay race: user-gesture gate in store.tsx
Router eval requires Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 for 100% (299/299)
Agent eval ~48% in test env (memory/briefing gaps); needs real Ollama+llama3.1 for full pass
Many backend tests fail due to pre-existing missing HermesAdapter methods (recent_events, emit_gateway, etc.) - not regressions
Vite proxy MUST keep changeOrigin: false - guard.py compares browser Origin host with Host; rewriting breaks PATCH onboarding/settings with 403
AURA_DATA_DIR isolates uploads/backups for tests; AURA_DB_PATH alone is insufficient
SQLite: single pooled connection, WAL + RLock. Restore swaps DB file and resets connection; never retain connection across restore
Schema changes -> schema.sql; existing columns need guarded ALTER in db.init_db(). Destructive drops need [allow-destructive-schema] in commit msg
Plugins: backend/app/plugins/ + $DATA_DIR/plugins/; plugin.*, R0-R2, stdlib-only, in-process (no sandbox)
Single-user, no login. OriginGuard != auth; preserve mutation guards, rate limits, webhook HMAC; don't assume public exposure safe
missing_features: Auth/multi-user (explicitly out of scope - single-user fortress, remote via Tailscale/VPN)
Gateway delivery to real provider APIs (currently audit-only, sends are records not silent delivery)
PWA push requires VAPID keys (scripts/gen_vapid.py) - inert without
Litestream replication off by default (AURA_LITESTREAM_REPLICA env var)
Server voice optional (requirements-voice.txt); browser voice is primary
ChromaDB optional (commented in requirements.txt) - built-in hashed embedding fallback works
OpenWakeWord model bundled but wake word off by default
Remote access needs Tailscale + HTTPS (serve/funnel) for mic/PWA secure context
WhatsApp Cloud API is generic webhook fallback; full Meta handshake works but needs live credentials
CalDAV push is best-effort only; Google Calendar needs OAuth client setup
Email IMAP live mode needs app passwords; sandbox mode has sample inbox only
Web search is keyless DuckDuckGo HTML (SSRF-guarded, 10s cap, honest off-state)
Kokoro TTS needs explicit one-time download (scripts/download_kokoro.py, 136MB)
Edge TTS needs edge-tts package; gated by Hybrid/Cloud privacy setting

production_checklist: version mirrors consistent: backend/app/config.py:APP_VERSION == frontend/package.json == frontend/src/App.tsx == docs/CHANGELOG.md
prod bundle present: frontend/dist/ exists (npm run build)
deploy files in place: Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, entrypoint.sh, litestream.yml
deployment_readiness.docker: Dockerfile builds backend+frontend; ollama in --profile lfm (optional); litestream entrypoint with restore-on-boot + replicate wrap
env_vars_required: AURA_CORS (* or comma-sep origins for credentials)
security: Rate limiting: sliding window per-IP (chat/upload/api scopes)
Secrets write-only via /api/settings (never returned in GET)
MCP: DNS pinning, no raw IPs, no private LAN, HTTPS only for remote, byte caps, redirect blocking
Approval flow for R2/R3 tools (30s timeout, expires_at cleanup)
Terminal: safe/guarded/dangerous classifier, footguns refused unless terminal_allow_dangerous=true
ops: Backup: one-click snapshot + uploads tarball with SHA-256, verified restore with safety copy
Litestream: continuous replication to S3/R2/file (one env var)
Retention pruning: nightly cleanup of activity/audit/toolcalls (retention_days setting)
Migration guard: CI diffs schema.sql base-vs-head, blocks drops without [allow-destructive-schema]
Health probes: 13 real service checks (Model Room, Terminal, Feeds, Weather are soft/degraded)
Cost controls: llm_usage journal, OpenRouter pricing snapshot, daily/monthly USD caps (BudgetExceeded fails closed to builtin)
